title: Cooling Tower & Water Tanks
description: Two RC cooling towers and their basins serving the direct and indirect water circuits of a water treatment plant (WTP) within a direct reduced iron (DRI) steel production facility.
scope: RC design, thermal gradient analysis, hydrostatic/hydrodynamic loading, pile foundation design.
keyFigures: Indirect tower: 75 m × 21 m × 4 m (height 16 m); direct tower: 15 m × 18 m × 4 m (height 12 m); concrete volume: ≈ 7,100 m³; reinforcement: 875 t.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 50 A1 sheets; steelwork/stairs drawings: 12 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Crack width control under combined thermal and hydrostatic loading.

title: Multi-Purpose Sports Hall
client: Cultural and Sports Complex | FIE Co.
description: Multi-purpose recreational facility of 9,300 m² with a 3,000-seat capacity, designed to host competitions including futsal, volleyball, and basketball.
scope: Design of steel frames and connections alongside internal RC structures comprising changing rooms and café, as well as reinforced concrete spectator platforms and foundations.
keyFigures: Clear span: 50 m; footprint: 50 × 78 m; ridge height: 23 m; structural steel: ≈ 417 t; foundation concrete: 1,360 m³.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 53 A1 sheets; steel structure drawings: 22 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
myRole: Structural designer for the steel portion; design reviewer and approver for the concrete portion.
challenge: Selecting an appropriate structural system posed a significant challenge given the unit-price contract nature of the project and strict architectural constraints. Through evaluation of alternatives, a MF system was adopted, achieving approximately 20% cost optimization — an outcome that directly led to my appointment as Project Manager for the full contract scope.

title: Continuous Casting Machine — Area 1
description: RC structures for a billet CCM (Continuous Casting Machine), designed to Danieli equipment requirements.
scope: RC design for high-temperature thermal gradients on thick walls and cooling chamber slabs, with settlement limitations imposed by Danieli for slabs and foundations.
keyFigures: Wall thickness: up to 800 mm; concrete volume: ≈ 2,700 m³; reinforcement: 310 t; design temperature: up to 140 °C.
deliverables: Concrete drawings: 71 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: The structure's complex geometry was dictated by equipment and process requirements. The design had to withstand extreme thermal conditions and heavy mechanical loads, including a 7,300 kN static ladle turret load.

title: Screen Building
description: Steel structure for the Screen Building in the 2.5 MTPY (million tonnes per year) iron ore pelletizing plant.
scope: Structural and foundation design of a screening building, accounting for dynamic equipment loads, with provision of support structures for screening machinery and inlet/outlet conveyor systems.
keyFigures: Dimensions: 27 × 18 × 25 m; structural steel: 414 t; foundation concrete: 1,450 m³; reinforcement: 165 t.
deliverables: Steelwork drawings: 60 A1 sheets; foundation drawings: 90 A1 sheets; full calculation reports.
challenge: Accommodating heavy vendor equipment loads while satisfying bearing pressure and punching shear limits on the foundations.
